summary: Pump-by-pump advice for travelling across time zones and for daylight saving time changes: what AAPS recalculates, which pumps adjust themselves, how Dana users keep home time and time-shift their profile or clear pump history, how the closed loop is paused for 3 hours after a DST change, and an Omnipod Dash workaround using a time zone without DST.

sections.heading: Timezone Change and Daylight Saving
sections.summary: Introduction: AAPS recalculates IOB, basal and sensitivity shortly after the phone's time zone changes.

sections.heading: Timezone change for Omnipod Dash
sections.summary: Refresh the Dash tab and switch profile away and back after a time zone change.

sections.heading: Timezone change for DanaR, Korean DanaR
sections.summary: No action needed, as these pumps' history is not used.

sections.heading: Timezone change for DanaRv2, DanaRS, Dana-i
sections.summary: These pumps' history has no time zone, so changing the phone's zone would duplicate records; two options follow.

sections.heading: Option 1: Keep home time and timeshift profile
sections.summary: Keep the phone on home time and activate the profile with a time shift matching the destination.

sections.heading: Option 2: Delete pump history
sections.summary: Steps after landing: change the phone's time zone, clear the pump history and set the pump's time before reconnecting.

sections.heading: Timezone Change for Insight
sections.summary: The driver syncs pump time automatically and the Insight records time changes; history before a clock reset is ignored.

sections.heading: Timezone Change for Accu-Chek Combo
sections.summary: The driver sets the pump's local time automatically and stores the time zone; adjustment is slow.

sections.heading: Timezone Change for Medtrum
sections.summary: The driver syncs pump time; running TBRs stop on a time change and manual time changes can affect IOB.

sections.heading: DAYLIGHT SAVING (DST)
sections.summary: Introduction to daylight saving changes and why some pumps are better adjusted while awake.

sections.heading: DST automatic adjustment for most pumps
sections.summary: The closed loop is disabled for 3 hours after a DST change with a notification beforehand; a profile switch afterwards restores it; be careful using COB and IOB in the calculator.

sections.heading: DST for Accu-Chek Insight
sections.summary: DST change is automatic, no action needed.

sections.heading: DST for Accu-Chek Combo
sections.summary: DST change is automatic, no action needed.

sections.heading: DST for Medtrum
sections.summary: DST change is automatic, no action needed.

sections.heading: DST for Omnipod Dash
sections.summary: Either accept the 3-hour fallback to profile basal, or switch the phone to a time zone without DST the day before.

sections.heading: Actions to take before the clock change
sections.summary: Steps for the Dash workaround: turn off automatic time zone on the phone, pick a non-DST zone with the same time, refresh the pump and switch profile, check IOB and COB, and switch back when IOB is low.

sections.heading: DST for Accu-Chek Combo
sections.summary: DST change is automatic, no action needed.
